preconditions: An existing target directory and the installed toolkit's Python environment.
Current task scope covers target configuration, agent directives/hooks and backend discovery; --scan-subnet extends probes to the local /24.
Preserve prior configuration and check existing MCP/settings JSON is readable with the expected object structure before setup.
The toolkit registry and target configuration directories must be writable; setup is not a dry-run or transaction.

expected_effects.effect: Probe local backend ports and model endpoints, then replace the toolkit backend registry; --scan-subnet extends the targets.
expected_effects.scope: Loopback by default, optional local /24 hosts, and toolkit configs/llm-endpoints.json.
expected_effects.basis: setup calls llm_backends.registry.refresh(scan_subnet=...) before modifying the target; refresh discovers and saves.
expected_effects.impact: Consumes network/CPU/I/O and updates backend metadata used by other projects; probe requests can appear in service logs.
expected_effects.verification: Use a controlled target and mocked discovery to inspect call scope and registry destination; verify live reachability separately when authorized.

expected_effects.effect: Merge botte-llm into .mcp.json and optionally register a detected OculiX MCP jar.
expected_effects.scope: The target .mcp.json, including existing server entries and machine-specific command paths.
expected_effects.basis: wire_mcp and wire_oculix_mcp parse, update and rewrite the document; unreadable or invalid JSON falls back to an empty object.
expected_effects.impact: Prepares tools for a later agent session. Existing named entries are replaced; invalid JSON may lose prior settings, and incompatible structures can raise an error.
expected_effects.verification: Compare parsed configuration with its prior contents, check unrelated servers and inspect the named commands; no server start is implied by registration.

expected_effects.effect: Write default routing configuration, policy, a preflight hook, directive pointers and a setup report.
expected_effects.basis: setup calls write_config, preflight.policy helpers, wire_hook and report writing. When requested, ensure_agents_md creates a missing AGENTS.md and links an existing CLAUDE.md instead of replacing its instructions. New hooks pin this installation's interpreter and absolute script path; existing hooks, including legacy module entries, remain unchanged.
expected_effects.impact: Changes future prompt handling and project configuration. Config/report are replaced, custom config is not merged, and existing directives can gain a pointer even without --create-agents-md.
expected_effects.verification: Diff every affected file; verify JSON shape, the installation-pinned new hook, preservation of existing legacy/custom hooks and policies, and additive AGENTS.md creation when CLAUDE.md already exists. Confirm all expected setup stages completed.

expected_effects.effect: Return and print setup details containing project/toolkit paths, backend metadata and names of configured cloud-key variables.
expected_effects.scope: Setup report, stdout and their consumers.
expected_effects.basis: _detect_cloud_keys returns environment variable names, not values; setup and cli.main expose configuration summaries.
expected_effects.impact: Supports onboarding but discloses machine metadata and consumes storage; setup does not measure subsequent savings.
expected_effects.verification: Inspect the report destination and fields before sharing; verify later routing with an authorized task rather than inferring it from the report.

downstream_effects.effect: A consuming agent may load the registered tools and execute the preflight hook on later prompts.
downstream_effects.scope: Later agent sessions, their selected models, tools and affected project resources.
downstream_effects.basis: Generated MCP entries and UserPromptSubmit settings are configuration consumed by the host, whose lifecycle is outside setup.
downstream_effects.impact: May change tool availability, context and routing costs. Local routing or zero cloud use is not guaranteed by installation.
downstream_effects.verification: Inspect the consuming agent's effective configuration and a small authorized task, including actual backend selection and results.

downstream_effects.effect: An interrupted or failed setup may leave a partially configured project and a changed shared backend registry.
downstream_effects.scope: Writes completed before the failing stage, including resources outside the target project.
downstream_effects.basis: Setup writes multiple files sequentially without backups, a transaction or rollback.
downstream_effects.impact: Blind retries can overwrite custom values again or operate on incomplete state.
downstream_effects.verification: Reconcile current files and completed stages with preserved originals before retrying or restoring selected changes.

reversibility.strategy: Restore specific prior configuration/directive contents and remove only entries introduced by this setup; reconcile shared registry changes and later agent activity separately.
residual_effects: Overwritten content cannot be recovered without a prior copy or other history.
Probe logs, captured output and actions already taken by the consuming agent may remain.

retry.check_before_retry: Inspect completed writes, JSON validity, custom config values, hook markers and backend/probe scope. Updating named entries is not full-operation idempotence.
retry.stop_condition: Resolve malformed configuration, failed writes or unclear partial state before another setup attempt; do not infer non-execution from a timeout.

required_scope: Existing authorization to configure the named project, modify its agent integration, write the toolkit registry and probe the selected hosts. This declaration does not extend task permissions.

analysis.summary: Setup has immediate configuration/network effects and delayed agent effects. Source review supports conditional repeatability of named entries, not transactional deployment, preservation of malformed files or proven token savings.
uncertainties: Imported discovery, policy and audit code is not included in these skill-local hashes.
Existing configuration shape, concurrent edits, consuming-agent behavior and future model costs vary by project.
There is no built-in dry-run, backup or automatic rollback.

The installed hook targets Claude Code; it does not install a Codex or cloud lifecycle hook. Shared Parcimonia guidance still requires the consuming host to read instructions and verify available tools.

reuse.target: Onboard another project to the toolkit's local-first routing configuration.
reuse.rationale: The target directory is an explicit input and setup writes a repeatable set of integration files.
adaptations: Review target JSON structures, existing custom routing, directive conventions and host hook compatibility.
Preserve original files and define probe scope and a project-specific recovery procedure.
reuse.validation: Exercise setup and repeat setup in a disposable target with representative existing configuration and mocked probes; compare files and validate subsequent agent behavior separately.
